item.title: An American Privacy Emergency
item.description:
📝 DAO-216-26 bans differential privacy and other modern (and not so modern) techniques. It bans swapping, used for decennial census publications since 1990. Until the recent directive, differential privacy was planned for the 2030 Census too.
🔗 Read more: https://scottaaronson.blog/?p=9902

item.title: crustc: entirety of `rustc`, translated to C
item.description:
📝 This is a functional Rust compiler you can build with GCC & make. This is a demo/teaser for my new Rust to C compiler toolchain. Reproduction Prerequisites This rust compiler was built on: uname -a Linux spark-2773 6.

item.title: Show HN: Inkwell – An RSS reader for e-ink devices
item.description:
📝 Background jobs pre-extract every article and transcode every embedded image, so a tap on the device fetches ready-to-render bytes from local disk. Documentation Installation — build from source, run under Docker, first configuration. Configuration reference — every YAML field and environment variable, with defaults.
🔗 Read more: https://kendal.codeberg.page/inkwell/
